kevin (Customer): Hey, I rotated our API key in the dashboard last night and since then every request returns 401 / invalid_api_key. We double-checked the key is active in the UI. Using the hosted endpoint https://api.redwood.com/v1/ — stacktrace/response below. Any ideas?

kevin (Customer): curl response: `{\n  \"error\": {\"type\": \"invalid_api_key\", \"message\": \"API key invalid or expired\"}\n}`

maria (Support): thanks for the report — sorry about the disruption. a couple quick checks: are you calling the hosted api (api.redwood.com) or a Dedicated/private endpoint? also can you paste the exact curl you're running (redact key)?

kevin (Customer): hosted (api.redwood.com). i run: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat -H \"Api-Key: REDACTED\" -d @payload.json`

maria (Support): ahhh that header looks like the issue. For hosted endpoints we require `Authorization: Bearer <KEY>` (not `Api-Key:`). Can you try: 
```\ncurl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACTED\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d @payload.json\n```

maria (Support): also confirm the key type — if it's a Dedicated key it will only work against your dedicated host (different hostname). Hosted keys vs dedicated keys are not interchangeable.

tyler (SRE): another common gotcha after rotation is trailing newline or copy/paste invisible chars. quick check on the client: `printf \"%s\" \"$KEY\" | od -An -t x1` should show contiguous bytes. if you see `0a` at end that's a newline. trim with `tr -d '\n'` or use `echo -n`.

kevin (Customer): omg that was it — our CI writes the key with a newline. ran `echo \"$KEY\" | od -An -t x1` and saw `... 31 32 33 0a`. removed newline and now requests succeed. thanks!! :raised_hands:

maria (Support): awesome — glad it was quick. leaving this thread as reference: header must be `Authorization: Bearer`, hosted vs dedicated keys differ, and watch for trailing whitespace/newlines when rotating. linking troubleshooting doc: https://docs.redwood.com/auth#headers (internal) :thumbsup:

kevin (Customer): leaving note for my team to update CI to `printf "%s" \"$KEY\"` and strip newlines. will reopen if it happens again. thanks team :white_check_mark:
